name: Zhongji Innolight Co., Ltd.
blurb: Zhongji Innolight Co., Ltd. (SZSE: 300308), headquartered in Longkou, Shandong, is the publicly listed parent of InnoLight Technology — one of the world's largest manufacturers of datacom optical transceiver modules. The company researches, designs, packages, and sells optical communication transceivers and devices for data-centre interconnects and telecom networks, with a deep cooperative relationship with North American hyperscalers. Its product roadmap spans 100G through 1.6T solutions, including silicon photonics, LPO (linear-drive pluggable), and CPO (co-packaged optics) platforms. Alongside Eoptolink (300502.SZ), InnoLight commands roughly 60% of Nvidia's 800G SFP optical module supply. The company appeared as a named competitor in Coherent Corp.'s 10-K filing.
recent: As of May 2026, Zhongji Innolight carries a market capitalisation of approximately 955 billion CNY, making it one of the largest listed photonics companies in China. At OFC 2025, InnoLight's subsidiary showcased 1.6T-DR8 and 2xFR4 OSFP modules using a 3nm DSP chip and 1.6T-2xLR4 modules based on TFLN MZM technology. Nvidia is expected to increase its 800G module orders to Innolight suppliers by 35% in 2026. Analyst consensus from Chinese brokerages is broadly Buy, with the stock rated a beneficiary of the strongest certainty of AI-driven demand.
